notes: Stills, GIFs and thumbnails now keep a clip's true colours. A frame saved as JPG from an HD video used to come out with greens and cyans noticeably too bright, and the thumbnails in your media bin had the same shift. Clips that carry no colour information, which is common for screen recordings and older exports, showed it in PNG stills, GIFs and the Compare view too. All of these now match the clip.
